item.title: Feed review for Book287284
item.description: "Principal leadership is more challenging now than ever. In The Purposeful Principal we have a practical guidebook to leading joyful schools where all students are supported on their journey toward success. The authors understand the intense demand on the time of principals and the importance of focusing on the practices that have the greatest impact on student success. The structure and practical guidance make this useful for new and veteran principals alike." Scott MenzelSuperintendent, Scotts

item.title: Feed review for Book287284
item.description: "The Purposeful Principal is a framework for meaningful job embedded professional learning for current or aspiring school leaders. With this book in hand, you can design your own year of professional growth to become that principal who solves real problems with audacious action. Filled with models and provocative questions for building leadership competencies, cross cultural connections, and a joyful school environment, this book is your guide to achieving an Every Student Succeeds Mindset."
